'''The Mountain of Light''' was a Mountain on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was where the [[Tree of Light]] was growing. Young [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] would travel here to sprinkle [[Light Dust|light dust]] on the tree to sustain it. For accomplishing that task, they earned a [[Silver Feather of Bravery|feather of light]].
